function.name: lookup_domain_info
function.description: Retrieves general business information (industry, size, revenue) about a company based on its domain name.

function.name: check_crm_history
function.description: Checks the internal CRM system for past contact, status, and notes associated with a specific lead email.

email.description: The full email address of the lead.

function.name: calculate_lead_score
function.description: Calculates the priority score (High/Medium/Low) for a lead based on the collected domain info and CRM history data.

domain_info.description: A JSON string containing the company domain information (industry, size, revenue).

crm_history.description: A JSON string containing the CRM history (last_contact, status, notes).
